title: 第17章 星辉之躯第18章 训练
lines: 黑暗，冰冷，虚无。
卡拉斯的意识碎片，在这片绝对的死寂中不知漂浮了多久，或许一瞬，或许永恒。
直到，一缕纯粹至极的暖意，如同刺破永夜的第一道曙光，轻柔地触碰到了他意识的边缘。
这温暖并非来自物质，它直接抚慰着灵魂，带着生命本源与浩瀚秩序的力量，开始将那些破碎的残片艰难地重新聚合。
感官，如同生锈的齿轮，在巨大的阻力下，嘎吱作响地重新转动。
温暖，包裹全身，如同回归母体，驱散骨髓里的寒意。
声音，由远及近，像是液态光芒流动的空灵嗡鸣，夹杂着大地脉动般的低沉呼吸。
视觉，最后恢复。
他睁开眼，没有预想中的刺目，只有一片流淌的、晨曦融金般的圣洁光芒。
他正浸泡在一个巨大得难以想象的池子中。
池水并非凡水，而是粘稠、温润如同熔融液态黄金的物质，其中沉浮着无数星辰碎屑般的光点，散发出磅礴的生命气息与秩序光辉。
白玉般的池壁上，天然铭刻着流动的金色符文，玄奥非凡。
穹顶高远如星空，金色光幕之外，隐约有山岳般的金色龙影巡游。
这里…是龙族圣殿？
卡拉斯试图移动，身体却被无形的力量温柔托举。
他下意识低头，看向自己的身体。
下一刻，强烈的震惊贯穿了他新生的意识！
他那具残破不堪的躯壳，消失了！
取而代之的，是一具全新的身体！
覆盖着一层温润如玉、却又坚韧无比的象牙白色奇异材质，紧密贴合着肌肉线条，流转着柔和光晕。
所有触目惊心的伤口、疤痕，全都无影无踪，连肋下那道致命的巨大创伤，也只留下一道淡淡的、树根纹理般的金色印记。
这身体里，充盈着他从未感受过的、内敛而澎湃的力量，如同沉睡的火山，随时可以爆发。
然而，紧随力量感而来的，是更深的惊骇——冰冷。
一种源自存在本身的冰冷。
他感受不到池水的温度，感受不到心跳，感受不到肌肉的收缩，这完美强大的身躯，像是一个没有生命的精密容器！
他的灵魂被禁锢其中，冰冷地“操作”
着一切，却失去了所有属于“人”
的触感！
恐慌，冰凉的恐慌，瞬间攫住了他。
这重生的代价，竟是失去血肉的感知？！
“无需恐惧，迷途的灵魂。”
一个宏大、低沉，却带着抚慰力量的意念，直接在他脑海响起。
卡拉斯猛地抬头。
池边，那头古老的审判金龙——阿斯特拉，正静静矗立。
它熔金般的竖瞳温和地注视着他，带着悲悯与疲惫。
“汝之残躯，已被混沌与吾族秩序本源重塑。
此身，名为‘星辉之躯’。”
阿斯特拉的意念回荡着，“它承载秩序之光，隔绝混沌之蚀，亦隔绝…凡尘之触。”
星辉之躯！
隔绝凡尘之触！
卡拉斯明白了。
血肉、温度、触感…所有为“人”
content_en:
Dark, cold, nothingness.
The fragments of Karas's consciousness floated in this absolute silence for an unknown length of time, maybe for a moment, maybe for eternity.
Until, a ray of pure warmth, like the first ray of dawn piercing the eternal night, gently touched the edge of his consciousness.
This warmth does not come from matter, it directly soothes the soul, and with the power of the origin of life and the vast order, it begins to reunite the broken fragments with difficulty.
The senses are like rusty gears, creaking and turning again under the huge resistance.
Warmth wraps around the whole body, like returning to the mother's body, dispelling the chill in the bone marrow.
The sound, from far to near, was like the ethereal buzz of liquid light flowing, mixed with the deep breathing of the earth's pulsation.
Vision, finally restored.
When he opened his eyes, there was no glare as expected, only a flowing, holy light like the morning sun melting into gold.
He was immersed in an unimaginably huge pool.
The water in the pool is not ordinary water, but a substance as thick and warm as molten liquid gold. There are countless light spots like star debris floating in it, exuding the majestic breath of life and the brilliance of order.
The white jade-like pool wall is naturally engraved with flowing golden runes, which is mysterious and extraordinary.
The dome is as high as the starry sky, and beyond the golden light curtain, there is a faint golden dragon shadow parading like a mountain.
This...is the Dragon Clan Temple?
Karas tried to move, but his body was gently lifted by an invisible force.
He subconsciously lowered his head and looked at his body.
The next moment, a strong shock penetrated his new consciousness!
His battered body disappeared!
Instead, there is a brand new body!
It is covered with a layer of strange ivory-white material that is as gentle as jade but extremely tough. It closely fits the muscle lines and exudes a soft halo.
All the shocking wounds and scars disappeared without a trace. Even the huge fatal wound under the ribs only left a faint golden mark like the texture of a tree root.
This body was filled with restrained and surging power that he had never felt before, like a sleeping volcano, ready to erupt at any time.
However, what followed immediately after the feeling of power was a deeper horror - coldness.
A coldness that comes from existence itself.
He couldn't feel the temperature of the pool water, couldn't feel the heartbeat, couldn't feel the contraction of the muscles. This perfect and powerful body was like a lifeless precision container!
His soul was imprisoned and "operated" coldly
Holding everything, but losing everything belonging to "people"
The touch!
Panic, cold panic, seized him instantly.
The price of this rebirth is the loss of flesh and blood perception? !
"No need to fear, lost soul."
A grand, low, but soothing thought sounded directly in his mind.
Karas looked up sharply.
Beside the pool, the ancient golden dragon of judgment, Astra, was standing quietly.
Its molten gold-like vertical pupils stared at him gently, with compassion and exhaustion.
"Your remaining body has been reshaped by chaos and the origin of order of our race.
This body is called the ‘Body of Starlight’. "
Astra's thoughts echoed, "It carries the light of order, isolates it from the erosion of chaos, and also isolates...the touch of mortal world."
The body of stars!
Isolated from the touch of mortal world!
Karas understood.
Flesh, temperature, touch...all are "human"
